destariamasteries:alchemy-mastery-desc: Turn nature's ingredients into deadly weapons and potent buffs. The Alchemy mastery unlocks the ability to brew powerful potions, coat weapons in lingering toxins, and unleash devastating explosive and chemical attacks.
destariamasteries:alchemy-basicconcoctio: Unlocks the ability to craft minor potions and poisons.
destariamasteries:alchemy-fungalnourishm: Consuming mushrooms provides {0} additional saturation and increases your healing effectiveness by {1}%% for 10 seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-toxictransmuta: Reduces the harmful effects of consuming mushrooms by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-fungalfingers-: Unlocks the ability to craft mushroom substrate.
destariamasteries:alchemy-virulentreacti: Increases the damage potency of your poisons by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-potentdecoctio: Unlocks the ability to craft highly potent potions and poisons.
destariamasteries:alchemy-dazzleblast-de: Blinds a targeted enemy for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-poisoncloud-de:
Creates a lingering cloud of poison for {0} seconds.
Requires a mushroom. The cloud's poison damage is dependent on the type of mushroom used.
destariamasteries:alchemy-concussiveblas: Deafens a targeted enemy for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-primedtoxin-de: Coats your equipped blade in poison, causing your attacks to poison targets for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-granddetonatio: Unlocks the ability to craft powerful explosives.
destariamasteries:alchemy-toxicreserves-: While poisoned, your movement speed is increased by {0}%% and hunger depletion is reduced by {1}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-costlymistake-: Inflicts poison upon yourself for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-catalyticsurge: Purges all poison effects from yourself, healing you for {0}%% of the damage the poison would have dealt.

The Mechanist mastery unlocks the ability to craft and utilize advanced mechanical devices, from automated turrets to explosive gadgets, giving you a technological advantage on the battlefield.
destariamasteries:mechanist-combatengine: Unlocks the ability to craft {0} and increases crossbow damage by {1}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-tinkering-de: {0} and increases damage against mechanical creatures by {1}%%
destariamasteries:mechanist-delicatetouc: You're used to working with small, fragile parts, so your touch is delicate and precise. Chisels, hammers, shears, saws, and knives you use have a {0}%% chance not to lose durability when they normally would.
destariamasteries:mechanist-tuning-desc: Unlocks the ability to craft and use the Tuning Spear
destariamasteries:mechanist-beasttamer-d: Decreases the damage of your Tuning Spear against mechanical creatures by {0}%%. {1}
destariamasteries:mechanist-beastslayer-: Increases the damage of your Tuning Spear against mechanical creatures by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-eyeforcrafts: While wearing glasses, you gain {0}%% more loot from mechanical creatures.
destariamasteries:mechanist-scrapmechani: Convert {0} metal scraps into {1} rusty gear(s).
destariamasteries:mechanist-antiarmor-de: Gain the Ability to craft the Goat Foot's Crossbow
destariamasteries:mechanist-temporaladju: Imbue once every 24 hours a rusty gear with your life energy to turn it into a temporal gear.
destariamasteries:mechanist-temporalinur: Reduces the rate at which you lose temporal stability by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-antianything: Gain the ability to craft the Windless Crossbow
destariamasteries:mechanist-producttesti: Reduces crossbow dispersion by {0}%% and increases crossbow damage by {1}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-refineddevel: Craft chutes with cupronickel for double the output.
destariamasteries:mechanist-wardagainstb: Understanding the mechanisms behind mechanical creatures makes you more adept at defending yourself from them. You take {0}%% less damage from mechanical creatures, and {1}%% less damage from other monsters.
destariamasteries:mechanist-turnbackthec: Once per day (resetting at 0:00 UTC), when dealt a fatal blow, time fractures to save you. Your body is thrown backward through time, rewinding you to your spawn point with {0}%% health.
destariamasteries:mechanist-stormchaser-: Your time spent around temporal machinery has given you insight to the energies that power them which has given you somewhat of a sixth sense for their ebb and flow. You always exactly know when the next temporal storm is coming.
destariamasteries:mechanist-temporaldeva: Once every 30 minutes, violently shatter a temporal gear to rip apart the fabric of time. All monsters within 12 blocks take {0} damage, leaving their corpses utterly mangled. The chronal backwash causes all players in the area to lose {1}%% temporal stability within one second and slows them by {1}%% for 2 seconds.
